summary: Mynd.ai, Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a NYSE American notice for non-compliance with continued listing standards (stockholders' deficit of $(17.5M) and losses in 3 of 4 fiscal years). The company must submit a compliance plan by July 2, 2026, with a cure deadline of December 2, 2027. No price, premium, or deal terms are applicable; this is a listing-standard deficiency notice. There is no board recommendation or advisor named, and the stock remains listed during the cure period. Key watchpoint is whether the plan is accepted and compliance regained; otherwise, delisting proceedings commence.
